# Pyrotechnics Guild International

> > The Pyrotechnics Guild International (PGI) is the premier organization for fireworks enthusiasts, display operators, and pyrotechnic professionals, promoting safety education and community through annual conventions and certification programs.

Founded by Max P. Vander Horck, PGI serves hobbyists and professionals through its Display Operator Certification Program, NFPA compliance standards, the PGI Bulletin publication, and the Junior Pyrotechnic Association for youth education. The organization hosts annual fireworks festivals and provides comprehensive training resources for safe pyrotechnic practices.

## Key Topics

- Display Operator Certification Program
- NFPA 1123 and NFPA 1124 Standards
- PGI Annual Convention
- Fireworks Safety and Training
- PGI Bulletin
- Junior Pyrotechnic Association (JPA)
- Professional Use Only Products
- Western Pyrotechnic Association
- Ignition Point Podcast
- PGI Membership Levels
- Pyrotechnics Education
- National Fire Protection Association Compliance
- Display Operator Training
- Fireworks Community and Regional Clubs

## Getting Started with PGI

- [Home Page](https://pgi.org): PGI homepage for fireworks enthusiasts and annual convention information
- [About the Guild](https://pgi.org/pages/about-the-guild): PGI mission, history, and fireworks community education overview
- [Why Pyro?](https://pgi.org/pages/why-pyro): Benefits of PGI membership for hobbyists and display operators
- [How do I join the PGI?](https://pgi.org/pages/join-pgi): PGI membership registration process and member benefits overview
- [Our History](https://pgi.org/pages/history): PGI founding by Max P. Vander Horck and organizational timeline

## Membership and Access

- [Membership](https://pgi.org/pages/membership): PGI membership levels, rates, and benefits including PGI Bulletin access
- [PGI Access & Membership Levels](https://pgi.org/pages/pgi-access-and-membership-levels): PGI membership tiers, access levels, and convention registration details
- [The Junior Pyrotechnic Association](https://pgi.org/pages/junior-pyros): Junior Pyrotechnic Association (JPA) youth membership and education program

## Safety and Certification

- [Safety](https://pgi.org/pages/safety): PGI safety standards, NFPA compliance, and Display Operator Certification
- [PGI Shooter's Certification Study Guide](https://pgi.org/store/pgi-shooters-certification-study-guide-doc-book.6): PGI Shooter's Certification Study Guide for Display Operator training
- [Introduction to Professional Use Only Products Handout](https://pgi.org/store/introduction-to-professional-use-only-products-handout.7): PGI Training handout on professional-use-only pyrotechnic products
- [Licenses and Permits](https://pgi.org/permits): Fireworks licensing and permits for Minnesota and Boone County conventions

## Annual Conventions and Events

- [2026 Wisconsin Fireworks Festival](https://pgi.org/shows): 2026 Wisconsin Fireworks Festival at Wisconsin International Raceway
- [Past Conventions](https://pgi.org/pages/past-conventions): Archive of PGI annual conventions in Iowa, Minnesota, and Wisconsin

## Community and Resources

- [Leadership](https://pgi.org/pages/leadership): PGI officers and board members including Craig Hetherington and AJ Burns
- [Ignition Point Podcast](https://pgi.org/pages/ignition-point-podcast): Ignition Point Podcast hosted by Adam Keeley and Joel Robinson
- [Resources and Other Pyrotechnic Organizations](https://pgi.org/pages/resources-and-other-pyrotechnic-organizations): Pyrotechnic organizations, regional clubs, and industry associations list
